Prevention: Try to keep distance to other sweet potato fields and to sweet potato storage facilities.
Crop rotate with cereal crops e.g. maize.
Plant barrier crops (cassava, maize, banana, sorghum) to restrict movement of weevils between fields.
Use pesticides judiciously to conserve natural enemies (predatory ants, earwigs, spiders, ground beetles).
Hill or mulch to avoid exposure of roots to weevils.
Maintain moist soil with irrigation to reduce pest infestation.
Harvest the crop immediately after maturity and remove and destroy crop residues immediately.
Monitoring: Legless white coloured grub with a comparatively large brown or pale yellow head inside infested tubers or vines.
Thickened & malformed brownish to blackish vines.
Discoloration, cracking, or wilting of damaged vines.
Beetles of 6-8 mm length with a long pointed snout.
Direct Control: Apply products based on nematodes like karii/ Steinernema feltiae .
Restrictions: U When using a pesticide, always wear personnal protective equipment.
Always consult the most recent list of registered pesticides (PCPB).
Follow instructions on product label on
Farmers to always seek technical advice.
Apply products based on chlorontraniliprole 100 g/L + lambda-cyhalothrin 50 g/L.
